question.question_text: Did the camera wearer use the screwdriver or the pliers more often when working on the ground?

answer_options.text: Both tools were used with the same frequency on the ground
Neither the screwdriver nor the pliers were used on the ground; they were used on the switchboard

shared_investigation.established_facts: The camera wearer used the screwdriver to tighten screws on the electrical panel and wires, and used the pliers to cut wires. Both tools were used on the ground, but the screwdriver was used more frequently for tightening screws, while the pliers were used for cutting wires. The screwdriver was used more often on the ground.
